scope: Independent scratch-reuse design controls; expected semantics are preserved, not derived from candidate output.

groups.case: Repeated alias chain sharing a non-leaf alias: defs A->B, B integer, two root refs to A
groups.invariant: Second walk must not see stale A as a cycle.

groups.case: Long alias path then many short shared paths in one Run; reverse order as a paired control
groups.expected: Same S/F outcomes and original locations
groups.invariant: Scratch empty between traversals; later cleanup depends on live entries, not maximum bucket width.

groups.case: Repeated consuming array applications of the same alias-to-leaf schema
groups.expected: All integers S; last string F
groups.invariant: One scratch growth per Run, no stale membership or change to alias-leaf certificate.

groups.case: Static self alias and two-node alias cycle, with irrelevant acyclic aliases before/after in logical siblings
groups.expected: Existing independently required U/masked S/F answers unchanged
groups.invariant: Canonical cycle node and suffix membership depend only on current walk.

groups.case: Same original static target reached under distinct dynamic/recursive effective contexts
groups.invariant: Scratch reuse does not merge context keys or retain used-name evidence from earlier walk.

groups.case: Every observed cancellation and work/storage stop during entry, lookup, rehash, cycle suffix and return
groups.invariant: Every ordinary Result restores empty scratch; cleanup makes no post-failure ledger request.

groups.case: Forced Entries hash collisions, growth, partial failed push, reverse pops, then refill
groups.expected: Exact key lookup and ordered suffix behavior
groups.invariant: All bucket heads empty after cleanup; previous healthy active-stack behavior unchanged.

groups.case: First scalar and repeated same occurrence
groups.expected: Same identity; known hit checks work/cancellation and needs zero new pending backing
groups.invariant: No one-element Vec; canonical key/map allocations remain accounted.

groups.case: Strings with escaped-equivalent scalars, astral pairs, lone UTF-16 units and literal backslash-u text
groups.expected: Equal decoded UTF-16 duplicates fail uniqueness; distinct unit sequences remain distinct
groups.invariant: No Unicode scalar-only normalization or spelling identity.

groups.case: Objects with reversed member order and equivalent numeric spelling; arrays with reversed element order
groups.invariant: Object key-ID sorting and array order unchanged.

groups.case: Empty and nested arrays/objects, names sharing text with ordinary string values
groups.invariant: Postorder parent publication after all children; kind tags preserved.

groups.case: Equal and unequal composite const/enum operands in schema arena versus instance arena at matching local node IDs
groups.invariant: Occurrence key includes arena identity; no accidental cross-arena known hit.

groups.case: Cancellation/work/storage refusal during pending growth and after partial child interning
groups.invariant: No unfinished parent identity; pending backing drops; no partial success.

groups.case: Existing equal-subject/complementary effect controls plus descending equal child values in recursion
groups.invariant: Semantic equality does not replace occurrence-based consumption.

groups.case: Original reference-text-5000, unique-array, unique-objects, large-literal, late-duplicate, equal-decimals requests
groups.expected: Original strict observations, unchanged request bytes
groups.invariant: Actual allocation reduction measured in same phases/build; remaining retention and G6 flags stay visible.
